{{Quote|A Jedi without a lightsaber—"<br />"Is a lot less dashing to the girls."<br />"Not what I was going to say, but probably true.|Luke Skywalker and his son, Ben|<ref name="Backlash">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Backlash]]''</ref>}}
A '''lightsaber''' was constructed by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ben Skywalker]]. He used this weapon during his time as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. The lightsaber was single-bladed and used an aquamarine-blue crystal.

==History==
[[Ben Skywalker]] built an aquamarine-[[Color/Legends|blue]] bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] around the time he was training under his cousin [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]].<ref name="Betrayal" /> He used his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] while he was working with Jacen in the [[Galactic Alliance Guard]].<ref name="Bloodlines" /> He wielded it against [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], and [[Zekk]]. Ben accidentally injured Zekk which forced Jaina to take it away from him.

He reclaimed his weapon after it was confiscated when he was captured by [[Tahiri Veila]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Invincible" /> He continued to use this lightsaber during his travels across the galaxy with his [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|father]].<ref name="Outcast">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]''</ref> It was briefly used by [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Vestara Khai]] against the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].
